title: Kuruvi
desc: Vitrivel becomes caught in a web of crime and violence when he tracks down a man who holds his father as bonded labour along with many innocent people.
Sethuraman, a scientist, invents a time-travelling gadget that his evil twin Athreya wants to get hold of. Soon, a bitter battle arises between Sethuraman's son and Athreya.

title: Pailwaan
desc: A coach on the hunt for a new fighter finds Krishna, an orphan mentored by Sarkar. Krishna evolves into Kichcha, making a name for himself in the boxing ring.

title: Jilla
desc: Shakthi, the adopted son of Sivan, is a powerful gangster in Madurai. Although Shakthi bitterly hates the police, he is forced to become a policeman at his father's behest.

title: 7aum Arivu
desc: Dong Lee from China arrives in India to start a biological war. However, a genetic engineering student tries to revive the skills of Bodhidharma with the help of his descendant to defeat Dong Lee.
